newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps to review Monsanto debt.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps to review Monsanto debt.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Thursday it is reviewing its debt rating on Monsanto Co's debt after the company said it is analyzing alternatives for its chemical businesses.
Monsanto's notes, debentures and medium-term notes are rated Single-A-Plus and the company's commercial paper is rated D-One, DCR said.
DCR said it put Monsanto on "rating watch-uncertain," which means it could raise or lower the debt ratings.

Earlier Thursday, Monsanto said it is considering splitting into two corporations -- one a life sciences company and the other a chemical concern. Another alternative would be to merge its chemical business into companies outside Monsanto, the company said.

DCR said it will meet with management to evaluate the capital structure implications as the alternatives are considered. The chemical business accounted for about 41 percent of Monsanto's 1995 sales and about 29 percent of operating income, DCR said.
